#: mp_sub(a, b, b) growing b (s_mp_toom_mul's mp_sub(&a2, &a1, &a1), …): the tail callees s_mp_add(a, b, b), s_mp_sub(b, a, b), s_mp_sub(a, b, b) over b with the stored sign.

HPC: simp only [Iv.Disj, Disj, lay, eF, textIv] at hpa hpb hco

diff.TA: sp, pa, adp, pb, bdp, a, (b.withSign a.sign), H
diff.TR: ⟨hres.stk, hva.toShape, hvb.toShape.withSign _, hsz, hres.apos, hres.bpos, hres.coff⟩

lt.TA: sp, pb, bdp, pa, adp, (b.withSign {FLIP}), a, H
lt.TR: ⟨{STK}, hvb.toShape.withSign _, hva.toShape, by dsimp only [MpInt.withSign]; omega, hres.bpos, hres.apos, hres.coff, {LE_LT}⟩

ge.TA: sp, pa, adp, pb, bdp, a, (b.withSign b.sign), H
ge.TR: ⟨{STK}, hva.toShape, hvb.toShape.withSign _, by dsimp only [MpInt.withSign]; omega, hres.apos, hres.bpos, hres.coff, {LE_GE}⟩
